comparison.objective: Release a camera plate from a cam clamp and place it on a pad; candidate engages a collet retention ring.
comparison.physical_skill: Cam release, edge clearance, supported payload transfer, and placement versus groove capture and force-controlled snap insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Payload fully clear and stable upright on the pad without fixture damage/drop versus collet retained after release and withdrawal check.
comparison.reason: Release-and-transfer and snap preassembly test different abilities despite both involving passive retention.
